mostWorthwhile.text: Making banded iron was most worthwhile: it connected an observable geological record to oxygen reacting with dissolved iron before oxygen accumulated in the atmosphere.

surprise.text: The oxygen-rich sky could be deadly to organisms adapted to oxygen-free conditions, even as oxygen enabled other ways of living.
